reviewer: Codex visual inspection of saved PNG contact sheets

shape.notes: Near/far flakes occupy a broad volume rather than one small cluster.

color.notes: Cool white flakes contrast with the scene.

motion.notes: The population moves through the volume as snow drifts across the intended wind direction.

scale.notes: Randomized larger flake sizes improve visibility at the wide camera.

opacity.notes: Individual flakes fade in/out without opaque rectangles.

density.notes: Hundreds of flakes read as a broad storm; preview sampling gives 543 at 4.5 s rather than the analytic standard ceiling 660.

timing.notes: Viewed all four sampled times 0.10, 2.00, 4.50, 8.10 seconds. Live counts 18, 360, 543, 0; final frame has no live particles. This is sampled preview timing, not an engine runtime timing measurement.

scope: Original engineering example at recorded camera and seed; not a general art-quality or Minecraft runtime guarantee
